sloka: स विसृष्टो महावेगः शरीरान्तकरः शरः ।बिभेद हृदयं तस्य रावणस्य दुरात्मनः ।। ६.१११.१८ ।।
transliteration: sa visṛṣṭo mahāvegaḥ śarīrāntakaraḥ śaraḥ ।bibheda hṛdayaṁ tasya rāvaṇasya durātmanaḥ ।। 6.111.18 ।।

translations.english: Like the thunderbolt hurled by the arm of Indra, difficult to obstruct, capable of bringing life to an end, that arrow released by Rama penetrated into Ravana's chest.
